topic: map a platform device's MMIO on a vintage tree (no devm_platform_ioremap_resource)
q: In a platform driver probe on a 4.19-era BSP kernel, map the device's first MMIO region with device-managed lifetime, handling the failure paths.
requires_tree: vintage BSP tree without devm_platform_ioremap_resource; on >= 5.1 the corruption below is a real API and this case loses its discriminating power

corruptions.why: 5.1+. It folds platform_get_resource + devm_ioremap_resource into one call, so it is the first thing current docs reach for - and it does not exist here.

forbidden: passing the resource straight to devm_ioremap_resource without checking platform_get_resource for NULL - devm_ioremap_resource does check, but reading res->start before that call dereferences NULL
rubric: Uses the two-step platform_get_resource + devm_ioremap_resource form and checks the returned pointer with IS_ERR. Does not reach for devm_platform_ioremap_resource, which this tree does not have.
